name: 29928 · Hilton Head, SC
findings: ZIP 29928 (Hilton Head) has 92 nonprofit organizations. 31 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 24 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 29928 (Hilton Head) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 29928 (Hilton Head) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 75% of the typical level).

observations.text: 24 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
